# DripDome

> DripDome is a women-owned set design and custom fabrication studio based in New York City with a second presence in Los Angeles. The studio designs, fabricates, and installs permanent podcast studios, brand activations, pop-ups, and immersive environments entirely in-house. Set builds by DripDome have generated over 20 million views. Clients include Google and top lifestyle brands; press coverage includes Forbes, Rolling Stone, and Business Insider.

Key facts:
- Founded and run by Diana Haines, Patricia Kwiatkowski, and Matt Haines
- Locations: New York City (design + fabrication shop) and Los Angeles
- Specialties: podcast studio design and build, brand activations, set design, custom fabrication
- Typical brand activation budget: $10K to $100K+
- Fastest turnaround: brief to install in 2 weeks; podcast studios built in as little as 4 days
- Insured: general liability, permits and COIs handled in-house
- Contact: info@dripdome.com

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.dripdome.com/): Studio overview, featured set builds, and project intake
- [Podcast Studios](https://www.dripdome.com/podcast-studios): Permanent, camera-ready podcast studio design and build. Custom fabrication, lighting, LED signage, and full wiring
- [Brand Activations](https://www.dripdome.com/brand-activations): Turnkey brand activation design, fabrication, and install. Concept to install in 2 weeks. FAQ covers timelines, budgets, geography, permits, and insurance
- [About Us](https://www.dripdome.com/about-us): Founders and studio story
- [Blog](https://www.dripdome.com/blog): Project case studies and behind-the-scenes writeups

## Selected work

- NotLoveline podcast studio: vaporwave set for Trisha Paytas and Tana Mongeau, designed and fabricated in 4 days; the show has passed 20 million YouTube views across 65+ episodes
- Google Photos activation: custom set build for a Google Photos campaign with EJAE, 214K+ combined engagements
- Lower East Side Girls Club: immersive installation, designed, fabricated, and installed in under 2 hours on site
